book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MATEO

content: Yet yocto Comam Jesús yul con̈ob Jerusalén
Hayet ayto yapni Comam Jesús yeb ebnaj iscuywom bey Jerusalén yapni Comam bey Betfagé, iscawilal won̈an Olivo. Ischejnito Comam cawan̈ ebnaj iscuywom,
yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Asiꞌwe bey aldea cosatacꞌto tiꞌ, yet chexapno bey tuꞌ cheyilaꞌ huneꞌ noꞌ miꞌe burro xecan, ayco yunin noꞌ iscꞌatan̈; chepuholo noꞌ cat heyinoti noꞌ wetan.
Yajaꞌ ta ay tzet chihallax teyin̈ xin, cheyalaꞌ hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Ay chiocnico noꞌ yu Comam Jesús, yajaꞌ chon̈hulan̈ jakꞌaꞌpaxojan̈ noꞌ,” quexchi, ẍi Comam.
Hac tuꞌ yu yijni isba tzet tzꞌibn̈ebilcano yu huneꞌ ischejab Comam Dios yet payat hacaꞌ tiꞌ:

content.text: Halwe tet anma ay yul con̈ob Sión
Ilwecꞌanabi, lan̈an yul hereyal texol, huneꞌ heyahaw tiꞌ caw cꞌul iscꞌul, ayahto yiban̈ huneꞌ noꞌ tzeh burro, yunin huneꞌ noꞌ miꞌe burro ijtzom, ẍiayoj.

content: Isto ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ, isyijen ebnaj hacaꞌticꞌa yu yalni Comam.

Yet yapni ebnaj bey tuꞌ ispuhnilo ebnaj noꞌ miꞌe burro tuꞌ, yiniti ebnaj noꞌ yeb noꞌ yunin tet Comam. Islitxꞌbanahto ebnaj xil iskꞌap iskꞌan̈o yichin̈ noꞌ tzeh burro tuꞌ, lahwi tuꞌ yahto Comam yiban̈ noꞌ.
Caw hantan̈e anma oc tzujno yinta Comam, ay mac islebayo xil iskꞌap yul beh. Aypaxo mac inilo xaj te teꞌ
yanayo yul beh bay chiecꞌto Comam tuꞌ.

Sunil anma babelico sata Comam yeb tzujanico yintaj, ichico yawi yin̈ caw ip, chalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¡Caw niman yelapno naj tiꞌ, haꞌ naj tiꞌ titna yin̈ yuninal jichmam rey David! ¡Jalaꞌwe tzotiꞌ cꞌul yin̈ mac chihul coxol yu Comam Dios! ¡Jakꞌaꞌwe yuchꞌandiosal tet Comam Dios ay satcan̈! ẍi anma.
Hayet yapni Comam bey Jerusalén, iswejchacan̈ anma sunil, iskꞌambeni: —¿Mac anmahil huneꞌ naj tiꞌ? ẍi anma.
Istakꞌwi huntekꞌanxa ebnaj: —Haꞌ naj tiꞌ Jesús, ischejab Comam Dios ay bey Nazaret yul ismajul Galilea, ẍi ebnaj.
Yet istzumbenilti Comam Jesús ebnaj chitxon̈wi yul yatut Comam Dios

Lahwi tuꞌ xin yocto Comam Jesús yul yatut Comam Dios, istzumbenilti sunil anma chitxon̈wi yeb chilokꞌwi bey tuꞌ. Iswacchancan̈ Comam ismeẍa ebnaj helom melyu, ispacꞌchanpaxocan̈ Comam isẍila ebnaj txon̈om palamuch.
Yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Tzꞌibn̈ebilcano yul Yum Comam Dios hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Haꞌ watutan yet txah yehi,” ẍiayoj. Yajaꞌ hex tiꞌ hacaꞌ hunu isn̈achꞌen elkꞌom, hac tuꞌ ye heyu, ẍi Comam.
Hayet ayicto Comam yul yatut Comam Dios tuꞌ yapni huntekꞌan ebnaj mach chu yilni yeb ebnaj txꞌoj ye yoj; yakꞌni cawxo Comam ebnaj.

Hayet yilni ebnaj yahawil yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote, yeb ebnaj cuywawom yin̈ ley huntekꞌan cꞌaybalcꞌule iswatxꞌe Comam tuꞌ caw tit ishowal ebnaj; yeb yet yaben ebnaj yalni niẍte unin: “Jakꞌaweco ismay iscꞌahol jichmam rey David,” ẍi,
yalni ebnaj tet Comam: —¿Chimhawabe tzet chal niẍte unin tiꞌ? ẍi ebnaj. Istakꞌwi Comam: —Hoꞌ chiwabehan, yajaꞌ ¿tom maẍto bay cheyil yul Yum Comam Dios bay chal hacaꞌ tiꞌ?:

content.text: Haꞌ niẍte unin yeb niẍte chi-to-txutxwi haꞌ chakꞌan bitn̈eno habi, ẍiayoj, ẍi Comam.

content: Lahwi tuꞌ yel Comam yul con̈ob Jerusalén, isto yul con̈ob Betania, bey tuꞌ xin cancano Comam huneꞌ akꞌbal.
Yet istzꞌactiꞌn̈en Comam Jesús huneꞌ teꞌ higuera machi sat
Haxa hunxa tzꞌayic yin̈ caw sahab sacꞌayalil, ismeltzo Comam Jesús yul con̈ob Jerusalén. Yet ayco Comam yin̈ isbel tuꞌ isn̈ohchacan̈.

Yilnito Comam huneꞌ teꞌ higuera istiꞌ beh, isto Comam yich teꞌ, yilni Comam ta machi sat teꞌ, xajn̈e teꞌ aycoj. Yalni Comam yin̈ teꞌ hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¡Matxa bakꞌinal chachsatni! ẍi Comam. Yin̈n̈ena tuꞌ xin istajilo teꞌ.
Hayet yilni ebnaj iscuywom Comam huneꞌ tuꞌ, caw cꞌaycan̈ iscꞌul ebnaj, iskꞌamben ebnaj tet Comam: —¿Tzet mayu istajnalo teꞌ yin̈ an̈e? ẍi ebnaj.

Yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, ta caw cheyaco heyanma yin̈ Comam Dios, machi xin chicabcon hecꞌul, maẍn̈etaj huneꞌ mayu yin̈ teꞌ higuera tiꞌ chisje hewatxꞌeni. Wal xin tato cheyal tet huneꞌ witz tiꞌ: “Heqꞌuilo haba bey tiꞌ cat hato hawanoyto haba xol haꞌ mar,” ta quexchi, chiyij isba tzet cheyala.
Yuxin ta yin̈ sunil heyanma chextxahli tet Comam Dios yet chekꞌanni hunu tzet ye tuꞌ, chiakꞌlax teyet, ẍi Comam.
Kꞌambelax bay chitit yip Comam Jesús

Lahwi tuꞌ xin, yapni Comam Jesús yul con̈ob Jerusalén, yocto Comam yul yatut Comam Dios. Hayet lan̈an iscuywa Comam xin ishitzico ebnaj yahawil yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote, yeb ebnaj ichamta winaj iswiꞌehal yin̈ ebnaj Israel, iskꞌamben ebnaj tet Comam: —¿Mac cachchejni hawatxꞌen huntekꞌan hawatxꞌe yet ewi? ¿Mac akꞌni hawip? ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi Comam: —Haquintuꞌan ay huneꞌ inkꞌambebalan teyet, ta chepajtze wetan chiwalan mac akꞌn̈e wipan inwatxꞌenan huntekꞌan tuꞌ.

¿Mac chejniti naj Juan yanocan̈ haꞌ iswiꞌ anma? ¿Tom Comam Dios mato haꞌ anma? ẍi Comam. Yichico ebnaj yallen tet hunun hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Tato chijalaꞌ ta Comam Dios chejniti naj Juan tuꞌ, chimyalaꞌ naj jet: “¿Tzet yin̈ xin mach heyayto yul heyanma yin̈ tzet yal naj?” ẍim naj.
“Yajaꞌ ta chijalpaxoj ta haꞌ anma chejn̈e naj, chon̈xiw jalni yuto sunil anma chianayto yul yanma tato naj Juan tuꞌ ischejab Comam Dios ye naj,” ẍi ebnaj.
Yuxin takꞌwi ebnaj tet Comam: —Mach johtajojan̈, ẍi ebnaj. Yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Haquintuꞌan mach chiwalan mac akꞌn̈e wipan inwatxꞌenan huntekꞌan tuꞌ, ẍi Comam.
Yechel yin̈ cawan̈ ebnaj cꞌahole

Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús tet ebnaj hunelxa: —¿Tzet cheyute heyalni yin̈ huneꞌ chiwaltiꞌan? Ay huneꞌ naj mame ay cawan̈ iscꞌahol; yalni naj tet naj babel hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Cꞌahol, as munlahan̈ xol teꞌ uva,” ẍi naj.
Istakꞌwi naj: “¡Mach chintohan!” ẍi naj. Yajaꞌ tzujanxa xin yoc yin̈ isnabal naj istohi.
Lahwi tuꞌ yalnipaxo naj mame tuꞌ tet naj iscab tato chitopaxo naj munil; istakꞌwi naj: “Cꞌulticꞌa mam chintohan,” ẍi naj. Yajaꞌ xin mach to naj.

¿Mac xin najil yijen tzet yal ismam yin̈ ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ? ẍi Comam. Istakꞌwi ebnaj: —Naj babel, ẍi ebnaj. Yalni Comam: —Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, ebnaj ikꞌomilo tohlabal yeb ebix ix txꞌoj ye iswiꞌ haꞌ chioc babel yul iskꞌab Comam Dios tesataj.

Yuto hulicꞌo naj Juan anican̈ haꞌ iswiꞌ anma quexiscuyuꞌ yin̈ iscꞌulal, yajaꞌ mach heyayto yul heyanma yin̈ tzet yal naj. Wal ebnaj ikꞌomilo tohlabal yeb ebix txꞌoj ye iswiꞌ yayto yul yanma yin̈ tzet yal naj. Wal hex tiꞌ xin, waxan̈ca caw heyil huntekꞌan tuꞌ yajaꞌ mach hehel hebeybal, yeb xin mach heyayto yul heyanma, ẍi Comam Jesús.
Yechel yin̈ ebnaj munlawom mach cꞌuloj

Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús tet ebnaj: —Abewe huneꞌxa yechel chiwaltiꞌan: “Ay huneꞌ naj yahaw munil tzꞌunni teꞌ uva sat istxꞌotxꞌ, ispenayo naj istzꞌunub tuꞌ. Iswatxꞌen naj bay chiyatzꞌlax yal teꞌ, iswatxꞌenpaxocan̈ naj huneꞌ n̈a nimajal yucan̈ istel yun̈e istan̈elax huneꞌ peyab tuꞌ. Lahwi tuꞌ xin, yanito naj istzꞌunub tuꞌ comonal tet huntekꞌan ebnaj. Isto naj yul huneꞌxa con̈ob caw nahat.
Haxa yet yapni istiempohal yuxlax teꞌ uva tuꞌ xin, yanito naj huntekꞌan ischejab ischahno ismajul tet ebnaj munlawom tuꞌ.
Hayet yapni ebnaj chejab tuꞌ xin, yoc ebnaj istzabnoyo ebnaj, ismakꞌni ebnaj huneꞌ naj, hunxa naj makꞌbil ispotxꞌni ebnaj, haxa hunxa naj xin kꞌojlaxcan̈ naj.
Haxa yin̈ iscayel ecꞌbalxa ebnaj chejab yato naj yahaw munil, yajaꞌ xin hacticꞌapax tuꞌ utelax ebnaj yu ebnaj munlawom tuꞌ.
Yin̈xa istzujanil xin, haꞌ caw iscꞌahol naj yahaw munil tuꞌ yatoj, istxumni naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: ‘Wal tet naj incꞌaholtiꞌan chimisyije ebnaj,’ ẍi naj.

Yajaꞌ hayet yilni ebnaj yapni naj cꞌahole tuꞌ, yalni ebnaj tet hunun: ‘Haꞌ tet naj tiꞌ chicancano huneꞌ txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ tiꞌ, wal tinan̈ copotxꞌowe camo naj haxinwal jetxa chuco huneꞌ istxꞌotxꞌ naj tiꞌ,’ ẍi ebnaj.
Yoc ebnaj istzabnoyo naj, yilaxilto naj yintalto peyab tuꞌ yu ebnaj, ispotxꞌni ebnaj naj,” ẍi Comam.
Iskꞌamben Comam tet ebnaj: —Yet chihul naj yahaw munil tuꞌ, ¿tzettaxca chute naj ebnaj munlawom tuꞌ cheyute heyalni? ẍi Comam.

Istakꞌwi ebnaj: —Matxa chitzꞌay iscꞌul naj ispotxꞌni ebnaj munlawom txꞌoj tuꞌ, cat yanito naj istzꞌunub tuꞌ comonal tet huntekꞌanxa ebnaj munlawom tzꞌajan chu yakꞌni ismajul yet chiuxlax sat teꞌ uva tuꞌ, ẍi ebnaj.
Yalni Comam Jesús: —¿Tom maẍto cheyil yul Yum Comam Dios bay chal hacaꞌ tiꞌ?:

content.text: Haꞌ huneꞌ chꞌen chꞌen mach isje ebnaj watxꞌemcan̈ n̈a yakꞌaco yin̈ ismunil, haꞌ chꞌen caw ecꞌbalto cꞌul yoc xeꞌo n̈a. Haꞌ Comam watxꞌen̈e huneꞌ tuꞌ, caw xin chicꞌay cocꞌul jilni, ẍiayoj.

content: Yuxin chiwalan teyet ta nanxa con̈obal chioc yul iskꞌab Comam Dios heseleloj, yuto yijem anma tuꞌ yakꞌni ismajul yin̈ tzet chiswatxꞌe tet Comam.
Wal huneꞌ chꞌen chꞌen tuꞌ, ta ay mac chiaycꞌay yiban̈ chꞌen hayebtam iskꞌahilal chioqui. Yajaꞌ ta haꞌ chꞌen chiaycꞌay yiban̈, chiquechmoto yalan̈ chꞌen, ẍi Comam.
Hayet yaben ebnaj iswiꞌehal ebnaj sacerdote, yeb ebnaj fariseo yalni Comam hacaꞌ tuꞌ, istxumni ebnaj tato yin̈ ebnaj yal Comam huntekꞌan yechel tuꞌ.
Yuxin yoche ebnaj istzabayo Comam, yajaꞌ xiw ebnaj tet anma yuto sunil anma chalni tato ischejab Comam Dios ye Comam Jesús.

footnotes.text: Haꞌ won̈an Sión bey Jerusalén, haꞌ bey tuꞌ iswatxꞌe naj rey David yatut yeb iscapil ebnaj Israel yet payat
Yayo anma xaj teꞌ chꞌib yul isbeh Comam yuto caw chitzala anma yin̈ Comam. Yet payxa tuꞌ hac tuꞌ chute anma yet chocto hunu naj rey yul iscon̈ob
